This is done by finding the derivative of f(x) and equating it to 0 to solve for x. The solution of x is the x-coordinate of the point where the function has the minimum value. The value of the function at the x-coordinate found gives the minimum value of the function.
f(x) = x^2 + 4x + 8
f'(x) = 2x + 4
2x + 4 = 0
=> 2x = -4
=> x = -2
